value.name: enters Claire's house

value.name: Claire greets Asha formally
value.description: Claire addresses Asha in a professional, restrained way that signals tension and familiarity.
evidence: "Asha," she said, the way she would have said it to a client at intake

value.name: Claire silently asks Asha to follow
value.description: Claire nods without meeting Asha's eyes and turns toward the back of the house, implying Asha should come with her.
evidence: Claire nodded once, did not quite meet her eyes, and turned toward the back of the house without offering to take her coat, which Asha understood as both an apology and a request that she follow.

value.name: Asha follows Claire inside
value.description: Asha follows Claire down the hallway while carefully maintaining a respectful distance and observing signs of the household.
evidence: Asha followed Claire down the narrow runner at a half-step's distance, close enough to read the set of her shoulders but not close enough to crowd her, and let her eyes do the work her mouth was not doing yet.

value.name: notices signs of hurried departure
value.description: As she walks, Asha notices a man's jacket with keys in the pocket and a shoe left under the radiator, suggesting someone left in a hurry.
evidence: A man's jacket hung on the newel post with the keys still in the pocket, denting the cloth; a single shoe lay on its side under the radiator, as if kicked off in a hurry and not retrieved.

value.name: catalogues household clues
value.description: Asha mentally catalogs the visible objects and details in the house as she continues following Claire.
